candidates.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE isolated BROAD SHORT wooden bridge platform game sprite for an anonymous 11th–13th century Liao/Jin north-China town. IMPORTANT geometric repair: broad 3-by-5 rectangular deck, width equals SIXTY PERCENT of length. It is a wide compact rectangle, almost as broad as it is long, NOT a narrow footbridge. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric game camera with yaw 45° and elevation 30°; absolutely no perspective convergence. All width edges slope down-right at +0.5 and all length edges slope up-right at -0.5. Equal screen scale on the two horizontal world axes. Long length runs bottom-left to top-right. The deck should read as a very broad timber rectangle with three units of open entrance width for five units of span. On a 1536x1024 canvas, use deck top corners roughly LEFT(150,585), FRONT(600,810), RIGHT(1350,435), BACK(900,210). Opposite edges parallel, near short edge's horizontal run 450, near long edge's horizontal run 750, exact ratio 0.6. These are construction instructions only; never draw guides, dimensions, labels or symbols. Two LOW plain square-post rails along the long edges, only three posts per long side. Rails low enough that all deck corners remain obvious. Both broad short ends fully open. Flat straight beam deck with thin wooden fascia, no arch, no ramp, minimal short plain supports, no water, no ground slab, no scenery. Realistic ancient-Chinese strategy-game sprite, physically credible old warm-grey brown timber with restrained fine wood grain and gently worn edges, muted palette and matching Song city-kit detail density. Upper-left light, tiny contact shadow to lower-right, no broad halo. Entire object inside transparent margins, OPAQUE WOOD and genuinely transparent RGBA background including rail gaps. Do not render a checkerboard, fog, tinted plate, backdrop or ground shadow cloud. No people, faces, lettering, plaque, watermark, metal or modern objects. Output just one finished broad 3:5 bridge sprite, one view.

candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the edit target, a wooden bridge sprite. Correct exactly two defects: (1) enlarge the width of the bridge deck by 25%, keeping its long span the same length; it currently measures about 0.49 width/length in screen-space edge horizontal runs, but must measure 0.60. Preserve simple square-post railing, medieval north-Chinese anonymous beam-bridge design, aged warm-grey matte brown timber and restrained grain, same realistic city-map sprite material density, upper-left light and minimal shade on the object itself. Flat deck, thin fascia, straight beams, open entrances, no arch. Keep all corners and all posts in frame with transparent padding. No background, river, land, faces, people, text, signs, watermark, modern metal or added decorative objects. Make just this single repaired broad 3:5 bridge as a true transparent RGBA game sprite. The correction must be conspicuous: the bridge is 25% broader than the input.
